Use semicolons (;) between multiple evaluator email addresses. Industry Guests are assigned only to Demo Day.
Keep Student ID, Actor ID and email values consistent with the related sheets. Names are included for human verification.
Upload the workbook in Excel Imports, run Preview, correct every error, then confirm the atomic import.
